newFeatures: Added Outfit Collection automation for scanning collection progress, acquiring eligible missing outfits, upgrading outfits, and submitting completed +2 outfits.
Added Auto Sell automation for configurable and automated inventory cleanup.
improvements: Improved automation recovery and state handling across supported game activities.
Improved handling of login screens and server availability during automation recovery.
Improved world map navigation and destination detection.
Improved UI interaction handling to reduce rapid or repeated actions during navigation.
Improved reward handling by stopping earlier when matched priority rewards are detected.
Improved overall automation reliability during delayed or interrupted game interactions.
fixes: Fixed Tailed Beast automation behavior when a defeated beast is removed from the map, allowing the automation to continue to the next valid target.
Fixed recovery cases where automation could remain stuck after game or connection state changes.
Fixed cases where repeated UI interactions could occur while navigation or another action was still in progress.
